guard: the Pi connector declares connector-core's exact event channel, only --events arms COTAL_EVENTS, and an armed launch carries a durable workspace root
why: A1-A4 cover the connector admission legs: declaration, shared derivation, explicit arm, and
the reserved environment names that must not bypass --events. The lifecycle retention seam
has a separate mutation configuration because it exercises extension.ts rather than this launch surface.

mutations.name: A1 delete the connector eventChannel declaration so armed spawn is refused before launch
mutations.expectRed: the Pi connector declares an event plane

mutations.name: A2 locally re-derive the channel with a plausible name key instead of core identity
mutations.expectRed: the connector event channel is connector-core's derivation by identity

mutations.name: A3 arm every launch so an unarmed Pi session can publish
mutations.expectRed: an unarmed Pi launch sets no COTAL_EVENTS

mutations.name: A4 remove the reserved spawn.env event guard so environment forwarding can arm an ungranted session
mutations.expectRed: spawn.env cannot re-arm an unarmed Pi launch
